title: An honest reply reveals a difference

captions.energy: Renewing an answer to recognised meaning

meaning: You can combine thanks for an opinion with asking for change and hear its meaning anew even when a familiar picture of honest conversation changes sharply.
text: On your Vishuddha, Temperance in the physical position appears in joining gratitude with a request to change how an answer is expressed. Judgement in energy encourages responding to a newly recognised meaning of honest conversation. The Tower in emotions brings a sharply changed picture. You can want an actual opinion without accepting every form of expression. New understanding may surprise without determining the quality of every earlier or later exchange.

For example, you thank each other for an honest opinion about a story and ask not to compare it with how someone else would have written it. Interest and a needed boundary remain together. **Honesty can gain a newly understandable meaning**. You explain wanting the personal impression of the text rather than competition with an absent model. This can sharply change an assumption that “Tell me honestly” permitted every evaluative form. The response actually wanted now can be discussed.

Sharpness grows if new meaning must immediately be accepted as the only correct one. Thanks and a boundary then become a demand for a preselected review. Constructive Judgement helps hear the actual question without assigning its answer. You can openly request another form and withstand surprise; honest conversation requires neither comparing people for persuasion nor guaranteeing only pleasant content after clarifying how you want to speak.
